summary: This note is a short Wikipedia-style biography of Alex Hirsch, an American writer, animator, voice actor, and producer. It identifies him as the creator of the animated series Gravity Falls, for which he voiced several characters and received BAFTA and Annie Awards. It also notes that he co-authored Gravity Falls: Journal 3 in 2016, a book that stayed on The New York Times Best Seller list for nearly a year.
one_line: Alex Hirsch is an American writer, animator, voice actor, and producer best known for creating the animated series Gravity Falls.
key_facts: Alexander Robert "Alex" Hirsch was born on June 18, 1985.
Alex Hirsch is an American writer, animator, voice actor, and producer.
Alex Hirsch is best known as the creator of the animated series Gravity Falls.
Gravity Falls is a Disney Channel / Disney XD animated television series.
Alex Hirsch provided the voices of Grunkle Stan, Soos, and Bill Cipher in Gravity Falls, among others.
Alex Hirsch earned BAFTA and Annie Awards for the Gravity Falls series.
In 2016, Alex Hirsch co-authored the book Gravity Falls: Journal 3.
Gravity Falls: Journal 3 appeared on The New York Times Best Seller list for nearly a year.
